name: generate_3d_asset
title: generate_3d_asset
description: Generates a 3D model from a text prompt using Meshy or Tripo3D, downloads it, and imports it into the project. THIS COSTS REAL MONEY at the provider, once per call, and the plugin enforces a per-session ceiling (ai_agent_os/assets/max_paid_calls). Do not call it speculatively, and do not re-call it because the first result 'looked wrong' — inspect what you got with capture_viewport_screenshot first. Generation is asynchronous and typically takes 30-120 seconds; the call returns as soon as the job is queued, and the finished path arrives as an 'asset_ready' event. Generated meshes arrive at arbitrary scale with no collision and a high triangle count, so run cleanup_mesh on the result before placing it in a scene.

prompt.description: What to generate. Concrete and physical works best: "a rusted steel ammo crate with a hinged lid" beats "a container".

name.description: Filename stem for the imported asset. Defaults to a slug of the prompt.

target_triangles.description: Ask the provider to remesh to roughly this budget. Better than decimating afterwards — the remesher knows the topology and preserves the silhouette.

cleanup.description: Flag the result as wanting a cleanup_mesh pass. Does not run it automatically — Blender may not be installed.

collision.description: Collision to request during the later cleanup pass.

returns.description: Immediate acknowledgement. The finished asset arrives as an 'asset_ready' event.

errors.no_api_key: No key for that provider. Add one in the dock's Settings or set the env var.
errors.unknown_provider: Provider is not one this plugin knows.
errors.already_running: An asset job is in flight; wait for it.
errors.budget_exhausted: The per-session paid-call limit has been reached.
errors.generation_failed: The provider could not generate that model.
errors.timeout: The job did not finish in time.
